Wololabana dɔw ye bana wɛrɛw taamasiɲɛw ye minnu bɛ bɔ farikolo fan bɛɛ la, i n'a fɔ ɲɔni walima balodɛsɛ.Wololabanawòlolabananleishmaniosewòlonpeauláppàbànanmaladie dɔwdɔ́wprndɔ́prncertainwmrphPL yeyécopEQU banabànanmaladie wɛrɛwwɛ́rɛwdtmwɛ́rɛdtmautrewmrphPL taamasiɲɛwtàamashiyɛnwntàamashyɛnnmarquewmrphPL yeyéppPP minnumínnuprnREL.PL2mînprnRELlumrphPL2 bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF bɔbɔ́vsortir farikolofàrikoloncorpsfàrincorpskólonos fanfànncôté bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout laláppà , iípers2SG n'n'pmCERT aàpers3SG fɔfɔ́vdire ɲɔniɲɔ̀ninnrougeoleɲɔ̀nmilninmrphDIM walimawàlímàconjou.bien balodɛsɛbálodɛsɛnpénuriebálovvivredɛ́sɛvéchouer .
